God is more willing to give to you than you could ever be willing to receive.
You don’t ‘say’ prayers, you pray from your heart to God.

You pray in the Name of Jesus to God the Father, not through Jesus
In this concise, yet comprehensive book on prayer, Pastor Chris puts paid to the wrong mindsets, doctrines and practices that have clogged the wheels of your prayer life and opens to you an effective prayer life in the New Testament. Praying The Right Way not only teaches you dynamic principles of effective prayer, but also ignites a passion for prayer within you. The principles are simple, the results guaranteed – a life full of joy and peace as you receive answers to your prayers …always.
